name: B10-0149/2025 (ECR) – White paper on the future of European defence
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants to see in the European Commission's upcoming white paper on the future of European defence. It calls for more defence spending and production, better coordination between member states, stronger cooperation with NATO, and protection of undersea cables and other key infrastructure. It also asks for easier financing for defence projects, more support for small defence companies, and help for Ukraine's defence industry. The text is a set of requests and opinions; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to include these points in its defence white paper.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, defence companies, NATO, and the European Investment Bank.
- **What happens next:** The Commission drafts the white paper; Parliament's requests may shape it.
